name: Kitchener

queries.query: Kitchener Canada official GIS parcel map land parcels ArcGIS REST
queries.result: First-party discovery found the City of Kitchener maps page, Kitchener GeoHub Land_Parcels metadata, and the Region of Waterloo Property_Parcels ArcGIS REST layer. The metadata describes city parcel boundaries and the regional assessment-parcel layer, but no export-safe open parcel sample was retained because the data are Teranet-derived/licensed.

queries.query: Kitchener Canada carte SIG officielle parcelles cadastrales registre foncier Waterloo
queries.result: La recherche officielle en français n'a pas trouvé une page française distincte de parcelles cadastrales pour Kitchener. Les résultats officiels disponibles renvoient au portail cartographique de la Ville et aux données régionales en anglais; aucune couche publique exportable et sûre n'a été conservée.

officialSources.observation: City of Kitchener GeoHub metadata: Land_Parcels is an active polygon representation of property boundaries, 77,563 features in the observed metadata, EPSG:26917, maintained continuously. It states the source is Teranet-derived and the data cannot be exported for external use; no sample was retained.

Official Region of Waterloo ArcGIS REST layer: Property_Parcels is a polygon layer, EPSG:26917, with native OBJECTID and RollNumber fields documented. The service description says parcels are received from Teranet and joined with MPAC assessment data; unsafe ownership/assessment fields were not requested.
Official City maps page links the public interactive mapping application and Kitchener GeoHub as the municipal GIS entry points.

requests.outcome: Fetched successfully. Page exposed the City interactive map and GeoHub links; no parcel service URL was embedded in the page itself.
Fetched successfully. Metadata exposed parcel scope, polygon type, EPSG:26917, approximate accuracy, continuous updates, Teranet-derived provenance, and the restriction against external export.

Fetched the current layer configuration. Geometry type is polygon; spatial reference is EPSG:26917; OBJECTID is the service object ID and RollNumber is a native source field. No unsafe fields were queried.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; TLS verification enabled; bounded 0.01-degree envelope around WUP point; outFields=OBJECTID; geometry returned only to ignored tmp evidence
requests.outcome: Successful bounded response with zero features. This exact bounded miss was not treated as evidence of citywide absence. No retained sample was created because the source metadata prohibits external export.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; TLS verification enabled; 2,000-meter radius around exact WUP point; outFields=OBJECTID; geometry returned only to ignored tmp evidence
requests.outcome: Successful bounded response with zero features. The point was not shifted and the miss was not treated as citywide absence.
Current City web-map configuration was fetched for route discovery; it exposed operational ArcGIS service URLs but no additional export-safe parcel endpoint.

registryBasis: The City of Kitchener GeoHub and Region of Waterloo GIS are first-party municipal/regional parcel custodians with documented parcel layers. This establishes a local/regional registry route, not permission to export Teranet-derived geometry or evidence of an adapter-ready public dataset.

remainingUncertainty: The official viewer and services may provide map display or licensed/internal access beyond these anonymous bounded requests. Exact-point and radius misses do not establish citywide absence. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, assessment, roll-number, or other unsafe values were requested or retained.
